build_einsum_layer: build a Flax Einsum module for parameterized tensor multiplication with a learnable weight matrix
build_clipped_einsum_layer: build a ClippedEinsum module that performs einsum with configurable input and output activation clamping
build_rmsnorm_layer: build an RMSNorm layer that normalizes inputs using root mean square with optional scaling
refactor_einsum_w_scale: refactor the Einsum module to apply a custom w_scale multiplier to the learned weight tensor
review_rmsnorm_with_scale: review the RMSNorm module and its with_scale parameter for conditional learnable scale multiplication
